mira.initial: The glass became warm before the floor did.
mira.one_clue: Leela told me not to look through it.
mira.two_clues: I tied my red ribbon where she could still see me.

leela.initial: I left something beside the water.
leela.one_clue: I could not go back for my shoe.
leela.two_clues: Mira was above me. I could hear her at the window.

arun.initial: The stars did not disappear. The smoke only covered them.
arun.one_clue: The library book showed me where to find north.
arun.two_clues: I drew the same stars for the projector.

dev.initial: It was already sparking. I told them.
dev.one_clue: My train made the same clicking sound.
dev.two_clues: The fire did not begin in the boiler. I checked.

sana.initial: Keep the cloth low. Do not breathe above it.
sana.two_clues: I counted seven cloths, even though the kitchen list had six names.

kabir.initial: I hid when the lights failed.
kabir.one_clue: My marble rolled beneath the desk.
kabir.two_clues: The register called me a coward. The desk kept me alive a little longer.

nila.initial: One... two... three... I keep losing one.
nila.one_clue: Mother said I was not supposed to be in the class.
nila.two_clues: There were seven of us. Why did they write only six?
